job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions truthfully and accurately. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to qualify. The application and supplemental responses will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualifications in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response. Questions answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification. Do not use generative artificial intelligence (AI) to respond to supplemental questions. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with LACOE. Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required - you must attach a copy of your diploma or transcript for review. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No education | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree
03. Please list the field in which you obtained your degree. If no degree, list "N/A".

04. How many years of experience do you have in compiling and analyzing program data regarding one of the following areas for one or more social services agencies: program planning and development; community assessment; student program recruitment, enrollment and eligibility; community outreach; family or community engagement; or program compliance monitoring? Options: No experience | Less than one year of experience | One year, but less than two years | Two years, but less than three years | Three years or more

05. In reference to Question 4, please check off the social services areas in which you have experience compiling and analyzing program data (check all that apply): Options: Program planning and development | Community assessment | Student program recruitment | Enrollment and eligibility | Community outreach | Family or community engagement | Program compliance monitoring | I do not have experience in any of the areas listed above

06. In reference to Questions 4 and 5, list the following requested information for which you compiled and analyzed program data: a) Job Title b) Name of the organization c) Dates of employment (month/year) d) Duties performed that relate to the areas checked off in Question 5 For each position held, please list the information in the order indicated above. Failure to provide the requested information may result in an incomplete application. Please write "N/A" if you do not have experience in this area.

07. How many years of experience do you have in preparing reports and recommendations regarding one of the following areas for one or more social services agencies: program planning and development; community assessment; student program recruitment, enrollment and eligibility; community outreach; family or community engagement; or program compliance monitoring? Options: No experience | Less than one year of experience | One year, but less than two years | Two years, but less than three years | Three years or more

08. In reference to Question 7, please check off the social services areas in which you have experience preparing reports and recommendations (check all that apply): Options: Program planning and development | Community assessment | Student program recruitment | Enrollment and eligibility | Community outreach | Family or community engagement | Program compliance monitoring | I do not have experience in any of the areas listed above

09. In reference to Questions 7 and 8, list the following requested information for which you prepared reports and recommendations: a) Job Title b) Name of the organization c) Dates of employment (month/year) d) Duties performed that relate to the areas checked off in Question 8 For each position held, please list the information in the order indicated above. Failure to provide the requested information may result in an incomplete application. Please write "N/A" if you do not have experience in this area.

10. The incumbent of this position is required to possess a valid driver’s license with access to private transportation, or demonstrate the ability to reliably travel between job sites using alternative means. Are you willing and able to comply with this requirement? Options: Yes | No
